# Module report — M10 (Rapports)

## T-207 — local report outputs (2026-10-29)
- **Built.** `server/lib/reports.ts` (pure monthly VAT recap and turnover shaping, CSV writers) and three routes:
  `GET /reports/tva-recap`, `GET /reports/revenue-summary`, `GET /reports/export/:type`.
- **Why two reports.** The existing « TVA collectée » report answers "how much tax" over an arbitrary range; a
  declaration needs it *per month and per rate* with the exempt base apart, and a business also needs its
  turnover month by month. Both were missing.
- **R-A.** Column labels and report titles go through the dictionary in both languages; no figure or label is
  hard-coded in the screen.
- **R-B / R-C.** Reading needs `reports.read`, the export is journalled, and the screen is read-only.
- **Live walk [EXECUTED].** VAT recap over 2026: 5 months, base 2 493 500, tax 374 980, exempt base 110 000,
  54 documents, per-rate detail present; turnover: taxable 3 311 880 + exempt 110 000 = 3 421 880 total,
  collected 1 902 700; both CSVs 200 `text/csv` with the French header line; unknown export 404; journal
  entries written.
- **Not verified.** The rendered report tables were not inspected in a browser (none here); figures and CSV
  content were checked through the API.
